name: barbell squat (on knees)
description: A kneeling squat with the barbell across the upper back. Lower your hips toward your heels, then extend the hips to return to tall kneeling.
instructions: Kneel on a padded surface with your knees about hip-width apart and the barbell secured across your upper back.
Brace your core and keep your torso upright as you slowly sit your hips back toward your heels.
Stop before your lower back rounds or your knees become uncomfortable.
Drive your hips forward and squeeze your glutes to return to tall kneeling. Keep your knees on the floor throughout.
